status: research; nothing here is read by the build
question: can a new centre model (partial pooling, latest pre-war months, pre-war forecast vintages, a small ensemble) beat '2021 held flat' for purchases from Russia (to_rus) and sales to Russia (from_rus)?
rule_pre_registered: a candidate replaces M0 only if (1) its accuracy (mean over H1-H5 of the median absolute cumulative log error, the site's cumulative error with 2026 at 8/12) is at least 15% better than M0 at EVERY rolling origin 2005-2016 (which include the classic 2007, 2012, 2016 tests); (2) it is not worse than M0 in any size class (S, M, L), pooled and at each classic origin; and (3) its era-calibrated 90% H5 band (the site's method) is not wider than M0's in any size class. The 2013 origin (2014-2018, Russia shock) is reported separately. A model that only reduces the small-buyer centre bias is reported as a finding, not proposed.

models.M0: 2021 held flat, the current method: origin-year level, or the median of the last three years for flows under EUR 1bn a year (S, M), as the map's small_flow_base
models.M0_last: start rule: the origin-year level for all sizes ('2021 held')
models.M0_med3: start rule: the median of the last three years for all sizes ('2019-2021 median')
models.MOM12: momentum: the latest 12 months before the forecast date (Feb of the origin year to Jan of the next; for 2022: Feb 2021-Jan 2022) from the country's monthly IMF IMTS report, as a ratio to its calendar origin year (real: fuel share deflated by monthly Brent), applied to the origin-year level; M0 where months are missing
models.MOMH2: momentum: the second half of the origin year annualised, as MOM12
models.POOL: partial pooling: per-year growth = b1 * r_c * (own 4-year trend - pooled cell trend) + b2 * pooled cell trend, applied h years from the M0 start; r_c = tau^2 / (tau^2 + s_c^2) (James-Stein reliability of the own trend, tau^2 the between-country trend variance in the cell); cells = size class x fuel-heavy (fuel >= 50% of purchases); b1, b2 in [0, 1] fitted on pre-origin back-test pairs (origins >= 2004, targets <= origin)
models.POOLr: as POOL with cells = size class x region (6 regions; cells under 8 countries use the size class)
models.FC: forecast-driven: log growth = e1 * cumulative partner real GDP growth + e2 * cumulative Russian real GDP growth, both from the IMF WEO vintage of the origin year (October; 2011: April); e1, e2 in [0, 3] fitted on pre-origin pairs with that vintage's history; no vintage before 2008 (origins 2005-2007 fall back to M0)
models.FCm: as FC with partner import volume (TM_RPCH) and Russia's export volume (TX_RPCH) from the WEO vintage; from_rus: partner GDP and Russia's import volume; only vintages from 2011-04 have them (earlier origins use FC)
models.ENS: median of M0, POOL and FC, year by year

data.to_rus: Russia's exports to each partner, CEPII BACI HS92 by HS2 (raw/oec_baci_r44), real by goods group (Russian export unit-value indices; other goods: FRED IREXFUELS)
data.from_rus: Russia's imports from each partner, CEPII BACI HS92 totals (raw/cf_models_r47), deflated by FRED IREXFUELS
data.monthly: IMF IMTS monthly own reports 2003-2018 (raw/cf_models_r47) and 2019-2026 (raw/imf_imts)
data.weo: IMF WEO country vintages via DBnomics (raw/cf_models_r47), 2008-04..2021-10
